title: CyberWitch is offered as the eighth theme in every picker, after side-by-side passes against the design at five widths

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04: get CyberWitch loaded into the system, 8 complete themes

detail: CyberWitch is built and registered (LIVE-2111) but hidden from every picker. Compare each page, Spotlight layout, Space and email with the zip's own at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000, fix the differences (the starter kits still use the borrowed Services blocks), then remove `cyberwitch` from RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS in lib/theme/site-style.ts, which moves the pinned theme-order and library tests (those pins need the owner's phrase), move /themes/cyberwitch into the sitemap and make it indexable.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/theme/site-style.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS[^=]*=\\s*new Set\\(\\[([^\\]]*)\\]/);if(!m||m[1].includes('cyberwitch')){console.error('cyberwitch is still hidden from the pickers');process.exit(1)}"
